title: Representative 7-PDF benchmark set creation, upload/runbook, and future few-shot planning
purpose: Define the seven-PDF benchmark set, upload/runbook, manifest examples, metrics interpretation, future ground-truth shape, and few-shot leakage policy before any extraction architecture rewrite.

user_pdf_context.job_9_policy: Job 9 is smoke-test-only and must not be used as benchmark ground truth.

required_categories.purpose: Clear text-native baseline with normal financial statement structure.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: Should be the easiest baseline if the user has at least one text-native PDF.
Important because most available PDFs are OCR/scanned or OCR-heavy.

required_categories.purpose: Difficult scanned/OCR PDF with blur, skew, shadows, small text, or inconsistent OCR.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: Use as OCR stress evidence, not the only success criterion.

required_categories.purpose: Dense tables with multiple year columns, subtotals/totals, and continuation pages.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: High priority for comparing current extraction to text/table-first prototypes.

required_categories.purpose: Notes/schedules with company-name-like detail rows and receivables/payables.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: Useful for testing whether future mapping candidates avoid broad concept overreach.

required_categories.purpose: Closest to expected real customer upload.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: Keep as holdout if possible. Do not use the same pages as few-shot examples unless excluded from evaluation.

required_categories.purpose: Unusual formatting, messy layout, mixed language, mixed scan/text, or other difficult case.
required_categories.expected_processing_notes: Stress test only. Do not treat this as the primary success criterion.

benchmark_vs_few_shot_policy.problem: Using the same PDFs or pages as few-shot prompt examples and benchmark evaluation targets causes benchmark leakage.

option_a_strict_benchmark_first.summary: Use all seven PDFs as benchmark/holdout first, record initial benchmark output, then select only small snippets from one or two PDFs as few-shot candidates later.

option_b_split_now.summary: Use five PDFs as benchmark/holdout and reserve two PDFs or selected pages as future few-shot candidates.

benchmark_vs_few_shot_policy.recommended_for_user: Use strict benchmark-first because only seven PDFs are available. After initial benchmark, select one or two small, manually verified snippets as few-shot examples and keep at least three to five PDFs/pages as holdout.
leakage_rules: Few-shot examples must be manually verified.
Few-shot examples should be small snippets, not entire PDFs.
Pages used in prompts must be excluded from benchmark scoring unless labeled as training/few-shot cases.
Do not evaluate few-shot improvements on exact examples used in the prompt.

benchmark_policy.minimum_before_architecture_prototype: At least 3 benchmark_candidate jobs, excluding Job 9.
benchmark_policy.seven_pdf_policy: Upload and benchmark all seven PDFs if possible; keep at least 3-5 PDFs/pages as holdout.
benchmark_policy.job_9_policy: Job 9 can test command execution and regression smoke only.
benchmark_policy.job_11_policy: Job 11 can remain a benchmark_candidate but should not be the only benchmark.
benchmark_policy.no_overfitting_policy: Do not optimize extraction/mapping architecture around one PDF.
benchmark_policy.cutover_policy: No new extraction architecture should be cut over until old vs new comparison exists on the representative benchmark set.

metrics_interpretation.rows_extracted: High or low alone does not prove correctness.
metrics_interpretation.template_field_id_coverage: Useful, but can hide wrong mappings.
metrics_interpretation.blank_statement_type: Should be near zero for fresh jobs.
metrics_interpretation.unmapped_rate: High means mapping/candidate generation needs work.
metrics_interpretation.duplicate_labels: May indicate extraction duplication or legitimate repeated financial rows.
metrics_interpretation.suspicious_signed_values: Manual review signal, not automatic error.
metrics_interpretation.arelle_baseline: Structural signal only, not submission-ready proof.

future_ground_truth_design.distinction_from_few_shot: Few-shot examples teach output style. Ground truth evaluates correctness.

recommended_next_feature.manual_step_first: User uploads seven representative PDFs through /app and records job IDs.
recommended_next_feature.next_feature_after_manual_upload: Feature #13J Run representative 7-PDF benchmark set and analyze results.
